character_semantics.core_scene: Broad seated cheek-held laugh, eyes happily closed, head/shoulders/paws act independently over clear feet; two gold sparkles retained.
character_semantics.omitted_optional_action: Damaged multi-face changes and the source forward-foot dissolve are omitted. Seated feet remain clean and grounded; meaningful head/shoulder/cheek giggle replaces that optional foot accent.
character_semantics.reversibility_or_contact: Both cheek-paw contacts follow the same head transform; wrist bases have reduced rotation. Both seated feet and sparkle centers pinned. No falling object or fluid reversed.

semantic_tradeoff: Damaged multi-face changes and the source forward-foot dissolve are omitted. Seated feet remain clean and grounded; meaningful head/shoulder/cheek giggle replaces that optional foot accent.

source_review.observation: Native0 shows a clean full laugh and both feet; own earlier curated52v2 was rejected for turquoise disappearing-foot patch, so it is never a source. Exact sole source PNG inspected at native512; no source eye/limb/prop ghost accepted.

candidate_visual_review.observation: Actually viewed all 84 decoded frames in four 256px contact sheets and native512 frames 0/17/34/59. The same two hands keep contact with the cheeks through two chuckle pulses and the gentle head tilt. Closed laughing eyelids, single nose/mouth, medal and side sparkles remain coherent. Feet stay grounded; no old turquoise belly patch, duplicated face, split limbs or sudden topology switch seen. This is a proposed scene-local cheek-held giggle, not acceptance inferred from numerical guard.

defects.reason: Сильний dissolve/ghosting голови між нахилами. f14–19 одночасно містять кілька облич, носів, очей і вух; f25–29 зберігають подвоєну голову та темний залишок matte над чубчиком. f12 і f31 уже мають зайві брови/контури.

proposed_description_uk: Весело хихоче, притиснувши лапки до щік: голівка схиляється вбік, плечі дрібно здригаються. Сидить стійко на двох ніжках, поруч блищать дві золоті іскорки.

strongest_objection.objection: A clean single source could become a generic bob instead of a laugh.
strongest_objection.author_response_and_limit: Two cheek contacts follow a specifically tilted laughing head, shoulders chuckle with a separate rhythm and tiny cheek presses; feet and sparkles stay pinned. This intentionally omits the rejected dissolving-foot accent. Independent QA must judge actual expression and motion.
